messages.subject: error on coxph survival model
parts:
Dear all,

Hi,

I simulated a data set with recurrent event data. Then fit a cox proportional hazard model for this data set. I got the following error that I don't understand its source:

> cutpoints = seq( 0, 2, len=10)
> formula = inla.surv(time, status, subject=subject) ~ covariate +
+ f(subject, model="iid", param=c(1,0.001))
> model = inla(formula, family="coxph", control.hazard=list(cutpoints=cutpoints),
+ data=dat)
Error in inla.expand.dataframe.2(y.surv, data.f, control.hazard = cont.hazard) :
  coxph with subject only works for fixed covariates


I appreciate for any guidelines to fix it.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: error on coxph survival model
parts:
On Thu, 2016-08-04 at 01:26 -0700, Hossein Baghishani wrote:
> Please see the attached
> 

using the correct names in 'inla.surv', like 'event' instead of
'status', make it work.

H



dat <- as.data.frame(cbind(simdata$stop, simdata$status, simdata$id,
simdata$x))
names(dat) <- c("time", "event", "subject", "covariate")
dat
cutpoints = seq( 0, 2, len=10)
formula = inla.surv(time, event, subject) ~ covariate +

f(subject, model="iid", param=c(1,0.001))
model = inla(formula, family="coxph",
control.hazard=list(cutpoints=cutpoints),

data=dat)
--
Håvard Rue
he...@r-inla.org
